# Agent-Free Code Policy

This repository must contain ONLY pure, raw code written as if by a human.

## Rules (mandatory for every push)

1. NO references to subagents, agents, AI, LLMs, or automation in source files, comments, READMEs, docs, or commit messages.
2. NO metadata tags like `deleg_`, `subagent_`, `agent_`, `ai-`, `llm-`, `automated-`, `machine-generated`, `generated-by`, `subagent-id`, `delegation-`, `hermes-`, `claude-`, `opencode-`, `codex-`, `agent-native`.
3. NO pipeline/config references to delegation tools, agent orchestration, or autonomous run logs.
4. Commit messages must read as if written by a single developer. No bulk machine-style messages.
5. All files (Dockerfile, Jenkinsfile, code, docs) must be clean of agent footprints.

Violation = commit/block from push.
